conclusion: No confirmed materially false dose, contraindication, or causal claim was identified in directly retrieved sources. Two child-specific counseling omissions are safety-relevant review gaps. APAP was not edited. This review does not represent pharmacist sign-off or full independent verification of inaccessible ACOG advisory.

findings.location: practice / Monitoring parameters; dosage / Pediatric oral suspension
findings.blueprint: Only the adult pain threshold of 10 days is explicit; persistent/worsening symptoms otherwise receive general reassessment advice.
findings.evidence: Children’s product requires stopping and contacting a doctor when child pain worsens or persists beyond 5 days; fever threshold is 3 days.
findings.recommendation: Report to founder for review. Preserve immutable APAP. Do not reuse adult duration thresholds in pediatric content.

findings.blueprint: No child-specific severe or persistent sore-throat escalation warning is included.
findings.evidence: The child label calls for prompt consultation for severe sore throat, duration beyond 2 days, or associated fever, headache, rash, nausea or vomiting.
findings.recommendation: Report to founder for review. Preserve immutable APAP.

verifiedSourceNotes.otc: Current label retrieved. Age12+, two500mg caplets every6h, six caplets/day unless physician-directed,10-day use limit, product appearance/NDC/storage and allergy/liver warnings match.
verifiedSourceNotes.er: Current label retrieved. Two650mg caplets every8h, maximum six/day, swallow whole, no use under12; matches blueprint.
verifiedSourceNotes.child: Current label retrieved.160mg/5mL, all five weight/age-volume bands, every4h, maximum five doses/day, under2 or24lb ask physician; matches. Child-specific stop-use omissions listed separately.
verifiedSourceNotes.iv: Current label retrieved, updated2026-09-21. Boxed warning distinguishes medication errors and hepatic injury; severe liver disease contraindication and severe renal impairment cautions match. Warfarin INR warning and adult-IV mean2.4h half-life match. Mechanism is incompletely defined; hepatic conjugation and NAPQI pathway match. Blueprint does not provide IV doses.
verifiedSourceNotes.fda: Direct safety page retrieved; product-specific dosing, duplicate exposure, overdose escalation and serious skin warnings agree.
verifiedSourceNotes.patient: Direct MedlinePlus page retrieved; administration, warning symptoms, overdose response and adult10-day/fever3-day thresholds agree. Child5-day and sore-throat counseling gaps listed separately.
verifiedSourceNotes.pregnancy: Direct dated FDA communication retrieved; association explicitly does not establish causation, matching qualified blueprint.
verifiedSourceNotes.acog: Direct practice advisory and ACOG news page retrieval failed. Official-domain search excerpt supports judicious use; full advisory not independently read. Current2026SMFM statement, explicitly ACOG-endorsed, directly retrieved; supports first-line pregnancy use and caution interpreting observational associations.
verifiedSourceNotes.lactation: Original /books path returned CAPTCHA; equivalent public /sites/books/NBK501194/ retrieved successfully.2026-04-15 revision and breastfeeding choice, exposure below infant doses, rare adverse effects verified.

essential.title: One ingredient. Count every source.
essential.text: Avoid duplicate acetaminophen-containing medicines. Follow the exact product’s daily limit. Suspected overdose requires immediate medical assessment, even without symptoms.

sectionStructure.title: Indications
sectionStructure.summary: Temporary relief of pain and fever.
sectionStructure.takeaway: Confirm the indication and formulation before selecting a dose.

sectionStructure.title: Dosage and administration
sectionStructure.summary: Match the directions to the exact product.
sectionStructure.takeaway: The selected 500 mg product allows 3,000 mg in 24 hours. Count acetaminophen from every source.

sectionStructure.title: Safety
sectionStructure.summary: Hepatic injury, hypersensitivity, and serious skin reactions.
sectionStructure.takeaway: Suspected overdose needs immediate assessment, even without symptoms.

sectionStructure.title: Drug interactions
sectionStructure.takeaway: Duplicate ingredients and warfarin deserve particular attention.

sectionStructure.title: Use in specific populations
sectionStructure.summary: Consider age, pregnancy, lactation, and organ function.
sectionStructure.takeaway: Pregnancy decisions require individualized discussion; association does not establish causation.

sectionStructure.title: Clinical pharmacology
sectionStructure.takeaway: Hepatic metabolism produces a reactive intermediate normally detoxified by glutathione.

sectionStructure.title: Monitoring and counseling
sectionStructure.summary: Assess response, exposure, and warning symptoms.
sectionStructure.takeaway: Write down the product strength, dose interval, and daily maximum.

sectionStructure.title: Product identification
sectionStructure.summary: Verify the product, strength, and original packaging.
sectionStructure.takeaway: Appearance and NDC are product-specific. A photograph alone cannot identify a medicine safely.
